summary: S2-004 is verified fixed. From the exact candidate, the creator emitted a 66-file lock, the lock was committed as the only path in a direct child of the candidate, and the full pinned post-lock validator passed with zero failures. The sole untracked frozen path was the allowed, gitignored FAQ PDF and its local SHA-256 matched the manifest pin; all 52 tracked frozen paths retained matching baseline Git blobs.
